title: doc: Move UAT tables back up a level in WSUG
description:
Unfortunately, while it makes more sense logically to put the
tables under the UAT listing, it changes the links of the individual
table sections in the chunked output from individual URLs to anchors,
which breaks the help buttons. That's a problem so long as #11266
is still open. Revert that part.
